criteria.description: One fullscreen hero, h1, description, labeled email, submit CTA, legal link, cover video, scrim, poster, and pause control; zero nav/logo/menu/second CTA
Permitted deterministic video is muted, autoplaying, looping, plays inline, cover-sized, and user-pausable
Form stacks narrow and forms a row when room exists; no overflow at 320/390/767/768/1280
Reduced motion pauses/hides moving media; JS-off retains static poster, native form action, and real legal destination
Visible label/focus, 44px targets, light/dark contrast, public ARIA, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
